immediate_review.description: Evaluator passes content immediately on first evaluation, clearing it for human review.

revise_then_review.description: Evaluator requests revision on attempt 0, then clears for human review on attempt 1.

retry_limit.description: Evaluator repeatedly requests revision until the maximum revision limit (default 2) is reached.

malformed.description: Evaluator returns a malformed response to test failure detection and graceful error handling.
